influences.name: Public Enemy
influences.context: Even before the deal I'd been listening to Public Enemy, especially Fear Of A Black Planet, which really blew me away.

influences.context: That lyric felt head and shoulders above everything else Nick and Rich had given us for Gold. It was a bit based on [the Clash's] Car Jamming and from Arrested Development

influences.name: West Side Story
influences.context: It had touches of West Side Story, for me.
